description: This PHP test class defines unit tests for the EmployeeClaimRequestAPI component within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It extends a base test case class, sets up test data, and contains methods to test creating, retrieving one, and retrieving all employee claim requests via the API.

classes.name: EmployeeClaimRequestAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeClaimRequestAPI endpoints, including create and retrieval functions, within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initializes test data fixtures before any tests are run.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of an employee claim request via API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test case data for the create test.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests fetching a single employee claim request via API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test case data for the getOne test.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all employee claim requests via API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test case data for the getAll test.
